title: Zoberry Ecommerce Shop Website
description: Full-stack enterprise E-Commerce solution featuring a responsive Next.js storefront, a dedicated Vite React admin dashboard, and a Node.js/Express REST backend. Built with MongoDB, Redux Toolkit, Redis caching, and Cloudinary for high-performance inventory and media management.
highlights: Architected a modular full-stack solution featuring a Next.js customer storefront, a dedicated Vite React admin panel, and an Express.js backend.
Integrated Upstash Redis caching and optimized MongoDB query performance to deliver sub-second page loads and fast API responses.
Implemented centralized state management with Redux Toolkit for cart handling, user wishlists, dynamic price filtering, and session persistence.
Developed a feature-rich Admin Dashboard using Material UI (@mui/x-data-grid) for complete inventory, category, user, and order management.
Built secure authentication & authorization workflows using NextAuth, JWT tokens, and password hashing with Bcrypt.
Integrated Cloudinary and Multer for optimized multi-image product uploads and media storage management.
Created automated catalog seeding and dry-run CLI tools for testing large product datasets efficiently.
Designed a high-converting, modern UI using Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI, Framer Motion animations, and Lenis smooth scrolling.

title: Janki Jiyana House
description: Developed a real-world D2C E-Commerce platform from scratch, covering customer experience, admin operations, inventory management, order processing, payment verification, SEO, and responsive design
highlights: Janki Jiyana House is a full-stack D2C E-Commerce platform built with the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). It features responsive UI, JWT authentication, product and category management, wishlist, cart, QR-based payment verification, order tracking, and a comprehensive admin dashboard. The platform also includes Cloudinary integration, SEO optimization, RESTful APIs, and role-based access control, delivering a scalable and production-ready solution for modern online businesses.

title: EduCore – Multi-Tenant School Management System
description:
EduCore is an enterprise-grade, full-stack multi-tenant School Management System designed to streamline academic operations, administrative tasks, and communication across educational institutions. 

Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) with Tailwind CSS, EduCore delivers role-tailored dashboards for Administrators, Teachers, Students, and Parents.
highlights: EduCore is an enterprise-grade multi-tenant School Management System designed to streamline academic operations, administration, and communication.
Key Features:
• Multi-Tenant & RBAC: Dedicated portals for Admins, Teachers, Students & Parents.
• Academic Management: Real-time attendance tracking, exam schedules, timetables & gradebooks.
• Payments & Alerts: Integrated Razorpay fee collection and automated email notifications.
• Media Storage: Seamless cloud document uploads via Cloudinary.
Tech Stack: React 19, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Vite & JWT.

title: Staylix Professional Hotel Booking Platform
description: A comprehensive full-stack hotel booking platform with real-time analytics, an AI-powered concierge chatbot, automated notifications, and payment processing.
highlights: AI Concierge Chatbot: Uses Groq AI (LLaMA 3.3) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for smart guest assistance.
Real-time Dashboards: Integrated interactive analytics and data visualization using Recharts and Socket.IO.
Background Jobs: Implemented automated emails and notification queues using Redis and Bull Queue.
Integrations: Seamlessly connected Razorpay, Cloudinary storage, Open-Meteo weather forecasts, and Google OAuth.

title: Home-Byts On-Demand Home-Service Chef Marketplace
description: A location-aware, on-demand home-service marketplace web application to discover nearby chefs, view availability, schedule bookings, and complete payments.
highlights: Location-Based Discovery: Leveraged geolocation queries to dynamically filter and showcase nearby home chefs.
Time-Slot Scheduling: Designed a booking system with pricing calculations, slot selection, and collision check logic.
Centralized State: Structured application state using Redux Toolkit slices, custom React hooks, and localStorage persistence.
Integrations & Forms: Integrated Axios client wrappers, multi-step validations, Firebase storage, and modular component libraries.

title: Syshop Ecommerce website
description: A robust full-stack eCommerce marketplace powered by the MERN stack, featuring comprehensive product catalogs, secure token sessions, active shopping carts, and dynamic inventory lookups.
highlights: JWT Security Protocols: Configured user registration, password hashing using bcrypt, and token-based state authorization.
Inventory Management: Programmed complex database queries and aggregations in MongoDB to handle dynamic product listing.
Interactive Checkout: Developed interactive cart states, checkout panels, and customer summary listings using Redux slices.
Scalable REST Architecture: Designed modular Express routers, standard middleware error handlers, and Axios API configurations.

title: Coza Store - Premium E-Commerce Client UI
description: A premium retail eCommerce storefront client frontend implementing interactive search, central cart state management, slide-in filter panel, and high fidelity image galleries.
highlights: Interactive Shop Operations: Built shopping carts and watchlists with active count updates using Redux Toolkit slices.
Custom UI Carousels: Structured product gallery view models, filter cards, and image zooms using Slick and Lightbox2.
Vite Build Flow: Setup a responsive, lightning fast Single Page Application (SPA) skeleton optimized for mobile touch actions.
Responsive Styling: Integrated vendor animations and mobile layouts utilizing modular CSS styles.
